acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Deep Ones family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Abyssal Hunter, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Lure-Ambush Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Broad eel-skinned body, first small glowing brow lure, trident, and barnacle-crusted shoulders.
Signature mechanic: False Horizon: the brow lure illuminates one point while the broad eel-skinned Hunter sets a trident thrust toward the shadow opposite it.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a hunter that separates gaze from attack by casting its first small lure across the arena.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no lure, no tentacles, no translucent organs, no kraken limbs, and no crown; T3 alone first gains its lure; T4 first gains tentacles and translucent organs; T5 alone gains kraken limbs and crown.
Engineered pressure bladders, shell valves, coherent conduit flow, reflective fill lines, mist jets, and visible drainage distinguish Water affinity from native ocean wetness.
counterplay: Ignore the lure endpoint, cross outside the opposite trident line, and punish the rigid barnacled shoulder. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no lure, no tentacles, no translucent organs, no kraken limbs, and no crown, so pressure loss exposes a shell valve; T3 lure marks the charged conduit; T4 tentacles and translucent organs reveal the draining organ; T5 kraken limbs and crown expose the commanded main valve.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating native wetness as Water affinity
identityInvariants: Hunched long-armed humanoid silhouette, wide flat head, lidless eyes, gill-neck, fins, webbed claws, and needle teeth remain legible.
Drowned green, deep-sea blue-black, sickly grey, pearlescent white, and bounded cold native light form the source palette.
Wet scale, eel skin, coral, barnacle, driftwood, rusted metal, whale bone, net, pearl, and shell remain distinct materials.
Pressure bulk, loss of familiar humanoid proportion, and native light-bearing anatomy escalate at explicit source tiers.
telegraph: The small lure brightens, barnacles grind on one shoulder, and the trident rotates away from the light.
